existing_or_coordinator_findings_assesse.title: Literal Git path decoding can fail after an intended source write
existing_or_coordinator_findings_assesse.evidence: source-interface-readback.json /results/0; exact retained technical Unicode demotion receipt is failed with recovery_required true; actual publisher _owner_proof rejects it as incomplete.
existing_or_coordinator_findings_assesse.reproduction_scope: Independently read the actual retained lifecycle fixture and called the frozen publisher source-proof function read-only. Source execution was performed by the distinct technical reviewer. Complete frozen control flow was inspected.
existing_or_coordinator_findings_assesse.cause: git diff --name-only returns quoted pathname text for ordinary Unicode/control characters; .decode().splitlines() is compared to literal allowed paths only after owner mutation/retirement.
existing_or_coordinator_findings_assesse.bounded_fix: Parse literal NUL-delimited Git paths with the native allowed-set semantics intact, and verify unrelated paths remain refused. Do not weaken the guard or use global core.quotePath configuration as the fix.
required_regressions: Actual prepare/apply/verify_completed with Unicode and newline owner paths for edit/rejection and demotion.
A genuine unrelated tracked modification remains rejected; failed partial operations preserve recovery evidence.
existing_or_coordinator_findings_assesse.publisher_consequence: The common source apply failure affects demotion. The publisher correctly refuses the failed source receipt; no distinct publisher pathname parser defect was found.

existing_or_coordinator_findings_assesse.title: Live source apply does not retain accepted HEAD and tracked-scope freshness
existing_or_coordinator_findings_assesse.evidence: source-interface-readback.json /results/1-3; root late_unrelated_tracked_commit and independent technical late_empty_commit/late_unrelated_tracked fixtures.
existing_or_coordinator_findings_assesse.reproduction_scope: Read exact plan, acceptance and receipt; compared literal NUL-delimited diffs against accepted baseline and current HEAD; called the actual frozen publisher source-proof interface without altering fixtures.
existing_or_coordinator_findings_assesse.cause: prepare checks HEAD and tracked cleanliness once. Repeated _recheck verifies selected owners and bound inputs but does not retain HEAD/tracked-scope checks. The final check compares against then-current HEAD, allowing a late committed unrelated file to disappear from its comparison.
existing_or_coordinator_findings_assesse.observed: The committed-unrelated fixture has a complete source receipt and verifies complete although its current HEAD differs from the accepted baseline and the accepted-baseline diff includes an unapproved tracked file. An uncommitted unrelated edit is noticed only after the owner mutation.
existing_or_coordinator_findings_assesse.bounded_fix: Enforce accepted-baseline HEAD and literal tracked-path scope throughout the live prepare/apply transition, including before writes and through completion; preserve intended-operation allowance and recovery behavior. Keep historical completed verification based on exact retained evidence rather than requiring HEAD to remain permanently frozen.
required_regressions: Late empty commit after prepare must refuse before owner mutation.
Late committed unrelated addition must refuse before owner mutation.
Late uncommitted unrelated tracked edit must refuse before owner mutation.
Test late boundaries during publication and completion; intended owner changes remain allowed.
Positive later historical verify_completed after legitimate mapping publication must remain valid.
existing_or_coordinator_findings_assesse.publisher_consequence: The publisher historical source-proof interface accepts the defective live-complete receipt, as designed for historical reconstruction. This is not proof of complete mapping publication bypass; the live source stage must prevent issuing the stale completion.
